description: Skelet G09-12 deterministic evidence-graded technology matcher

compatibility.instructions: Could the new matcher module, the populated unknown.technologyClues field, the evolved export gate and Markdown, or the CI test listing regress an existing P09 contract, consumer, or CI job?

correctness.instructions: Any lost signal, wrong match or non-match, wrong confidence, wrong ranking, broken merge, inaccurate truncation, regressed G09-08/G09-09/G09-10/G09-11 report or export contract, or analysisId instability?

evidence.instructions: Are the 15 new tests sufficient for rule calibration, prefix anchoring, host/path boundaries, merge, ranking determinism, unknown honesty, bounds, provider shape, report/export integration, and real Chromium end to end?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism across runs or locales, unhandled input shape escaping fail-closed TechClueError/ReportError/ExportError handling, or unbounded memory from crafted signals or clues?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond G09-12 graded matching: installed-technology claims, confidence 1.0, imported GPL datasets, transplanted crawlers or enrichment, live probing, or model inference?

security.instructions: Any script/HTML execution, network egress, GPL dataset import, prototype pollution, unsupported-scheme promotion, unbounded metadata, sparse-array bypass, invalid evidence promotion, or certainty laundering (heuristic match presented as observed fact)?

state.change: New pure tech-clue-matcher module with a frozen 10-rule Skelet-owned set (generator-prefix 0.85, host-suffix 0.6, path-token 0.5, path-prefix 0.55; no rule above 1.0; no regex engine; no imports), deterministic merge and ranking, bounded clues and refs, and a G05-02-shaped provider descriptor with egress none. Report assembly projects validated signals into graded clues with matcher provenance, an unmatched-signals gap, and never-installations disclaimers; unknown.technologyClues carries validated clues while other slots stay empty. Export surface validates clues, renders them as inert escaped Markdown with confidence and evidence links, and still fails closed on other slots and malformed clues. New 15-test suite with real Chromium end to end; CI lens job lists the new file (+1 line).
